findings.description: `turn_died` "says only when a nudge was typed" is off: `nudgeConductor` also records it when the steer is refused and nothing was typed (turn-watchdog.service.ts:186-192); "attempted" would be accurate.

The pane bullet calls the pane's scrollback "the transcript", the word the next bullet and decision 0179 use for Claude Code's transcript file; "the pane's scrollback carries no time" avoids reading it as a reason against the file.

process_issues.description: Docs-only PR (one new ADR): spawned only conventions and docs. correctness, security, context, simplicity, guards, maintainability and workflow-safety were skipped because no code, trust boundary, infra or workflow file is touched. spec was skipped because the PR closes no issue. The docs reviewer checked the ADR's code claims against src/core/cache-hold.service.ts and turn-watchdog.service.ts. The consolidator was skipped because only two distinct nits came back, with nothing to merge.
